text.text: One hub for every trip: dates and budget up top, then the plan, bookings and packing list. Open a trip to filter the views.
Compare what is booked with what you planned to spend.
Bookings total compares what you have committed with the budget you set for each trip. The sheet records your numbers only.
Costs here only record what you enter; they are not recommendations.
Bookings total is the sum of bookings linked to the trip.
Budget left is the budget minus bookings total; Budget check flags a trip when bookings pass the budget.
Plans carry an estimated cost for activities that are not booked yet.
Run this list a week before leaving. Anything you cannot tick today goes on the packing table with a due day.
A short list to run through a week before leaving.
